key_idea: Simulate the waves directly; the final partial wave hands leftover spots to schools that still have a team for that wave, in input order.
sketch: For wave w=1,2,... count schools with at least w teams. If capacity covers them all, accept and subtract; otherwise give the remaining spots one by one, in registration order, to schools that have a w-th team and stop. O(100*m). Pitfall: the leftover spots only go to schools that still have unaccepted teams, not to the first schools in the list regardless.
